newsitem.title: UK: RTZ shares drop on gloomy aluminium report.
newsitem.headline: RTZ shares drop on gloomy aluminium report.

text.p: Shares in metals and mining group RTZ Corp dropped sharply on Tuesday after a report in the Financial Times newspaper said the world aluminium market could be heading for a slump at the turn of the century.
RTZ shares dropped as low as 911p before paring losses slightly to trade at 914p by 1346 GMT, down 12-1/2p on the day. Just over one milion shares had changed hands.

Traders said the Financial Times article, citing a report from AME Mineral Economics of Sydney, had weighed on the share. THe report warned that expanding smelter capacity was likely to push up stocks and hit prices.
